title: Hikoya qilish texnikasi
goal_uz: Dars oxirida o‘z voqeangizni setting, muammo, keskin payt va yakun bilan, past simple, past continuous va past perfect zamonlarida, intriga va his-tuyg‘u iboralari yordamida qiziqarli aytib bera olasiz.

scenes.title: Hikoya qilish texnikasi
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Yigirma uchinchi darsga xush kelibsiz. Oldingi darsda ikki variantni taqqosladik va oxirida tanlovimizni asoslab aytdik. Bugun yana gapirish ustida ishlaymiz, lekin boshqacha: hikoya aytib berishni o‘rganamiz. Dars oxirida o‘zingizning bir voqeangizni boshi, o‘rtasi va oxiri bilan, to‘g‘ri zamonlarda va tinglovchini qiziqtirib aytib bera olasiz.
scenes.say: Hello again! Today we are going to learn how to tell a story that people really want to listen to, from the first sentence to the last.
scenes.say_uz: Yana salom! Bugun odamlar chin dildan tinglagisi keladigan hikoyani birinchi gapdan oxirgisigacha qanday aytishni o‘rganamiz.

scenes.title: Yaxshi hikoya nimadan iborat?
scenes.say_native: Yaxshi hikoyaning to‘rt qismi bor. Birinchi, setting: qayerda, qachon va kim bilan edi. Ikkinchi, muammo: odatiy hayot buzilgan payt. Uchinchi, climax, ya’ni eng keskin lahza. To‘rtinchi, yechim va yakun: nima bilan tugadi va siz nima o‘ylaysiz. Ko‘p o‘quvchi to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri voqeani aytib, joyi va vaqtini unutadi, tinglovchi esa adashib qoladi. Bu to‘rt qism sizga xarita vazifasini o‘taydi.
scenes.say: Every good story has four parts. First, the setting. Then a problem. Then the most exciting moment, and finally the result and an ending thought.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir yaxshi hikoya to‘rt qismdan iborat: setting, muammo, eng qiziq lahza va natija bilan yakuniy fikr.

scenes.title: Namuna hikoya
board: Last summer ... · Suddenly ... · In the end ...
scenes.say_native: Mana qisqa namuna. Har bir qismni ajrata olasizmi, shuni tinglang. Boshida joy va vaqt aytiladi, keyin muammo paydo bo‘ladi, so‘ng eng keskin payt keladi va oxirida yakun hamda his-tuyg‘u. Hikoya uzun emas, lekin to‘liq. Diqqat qiling: har bir gap voqeani oldinga suradi.
scenes.say: Last summer I was hiking alone in the mountains. Suddenly the weather changed and I realised I had lost the path. I walked for two hours in the rain. In the end I found a small hut, and a kind farmer gave me hot tea. I will never forget that night.
scenes.say_uz: O‘tgan yozda men tog‘da yolg‘iz sayr qilayotgan edim. To‘satdan ob-havo o‘zgardi va yo‘ldan adashganimni tushundim. Yomg‘irda ikki soat yurdim. Oxiri kichik kulbaga duch keldim va mehribon dehqon menga issiq choy berdi. Bu kechani hech qachon unutmayman.

scenes.title: Hikoyani boshlash
board: Last summer / A few years ago / When I was ten, ...
It all started when ... · I'll never forget the day ...
Let me tell you about the time ...

examples.t: It all started when I missed the last bus.
examples.uz: Hammasi oxirgi avtobusga kech qolganimdan boshlandi.

examples.t: I'll never forget the day I met my best friend.
examples.uz: Eng yaqin do‘stim bilan tanishgan kunni hech qachon unutmayman.

scenes.say_native: Hikoyani qanday boshlash kerak? Vaqtni aytib: ‘last summer’, ‘a few years ago’, ‘when I was ten’. Yoki intriga bilan: ‘It all started when...’, ya’ni ‘hammasi ... dan boshlandi’. Yana ‘I’ll never forget the day...’ va ‘Let me tell you about the time...’. Bunday boshlanish tinglovchiga signal beradi: hozir hikoya boshlanadi. O‘zbekchadagi ‘bir kuni...’ yoki ‘esimda...’ ga o‘xshaydi.
scenes.say: It all started when I missed the last bus. Let me tell you about the time I got lost in Istanbul. I will never forget the day I met my best friend.
scenes.say_uz: Hammasi oxirgi avtobusga kech qolganimdan boshlandi. Istanbulda adashib qolgan paytim haqida aytib beray. Eng yaqin do‘stim bilan tanishgan kunni hech qachon unutmayman.

scenes.title: Tuzilmadagi xatolar
board: ✓ Last night I was alone at home when ...
✗ ... and then ... and then ... and then ...
✓ After that / Meanwhile / In the end
scenes.say_native: Ikki xato. Birinchisi: joy va vaqtsiz boshlash. ‘Men qo‘rqdim’ desangiz, tinglovchi nima uchun qo‘rqqaningizni bilmaydi. Avval sahnani tasvirlang. Ikkinchisi: butun hikoyani ‘and then, and then’ bilan bog‘lash. Bu bolalarcha eshitiladi. O‘rniga ‘after that’, ‘meanwhile’, ‘a few minutes later’, ‘in the end’ kabi iboralardan foydalaning. Ularning ba’zilarini birozdan keyin batafsil ko‘ramiz.
scenes.say: Do not start in the middle. Set the scene first. And do not say and then, and then, and then all the time.
scenes.say_uz: O‘rtasidan boshlamang. Avval sahnani tasvirlang. Va doim and then, and then demang.

scenes.title: Qismlarni tartiblang
board: A  I finally got home and slept for ten hours.
B  Last winter I was travelling by train to Samarkand.
C  The train suddenly stopped in the middle of nowhere.
D  Everyone was nervous, so I started talking to a stranger.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Ekranda to‘rt jumla aralash turibdi. Ulardan hikoya qismlarini aniqlang: qaysi biri setting, qaysi biri muammo, qaysi biri keskin payt va qaysi biri yakun. Keyin to‘g‘ri tartibni baland ovozda ayting. Setting bilan boshlang.
scenes.say: Put the four sentences in the right order. Start with the setting.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rt gapni to‘g‘ri tartibga keltiring. Setting bilan boshlang.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javob: B, C, D, A. B ‘Last winter I was travelling...’ — setting. C ‘The train suddenly stopped...’ — muammo. D — odamlarning reaksiyasi, voqea rivoji. A — yakun. Yaxshi hikoyada har gap o‘z o‘rnida turadi. Agar A ni boshiga qo‘ysangiz, tinglovchi hikoyaning tugashini oldin bilib, qiziqishini yo‘qotardi.
scenes.say: Last winter I was travelling by train to Samarkand. The train suddenly stopped in the middle of nowhere. Everyone was nervous, so I started talking to a stranger. I finally got home and slept for ten hours.
scenes.say_uz: O‘tgan qishda Samarqandga poyezdda ketayotgan edim. Poyezd to‘satdan cho‘l o‘rtasida to‘xtadi. Hamma asabiylashdi, men notanish odam bilan gaplasha boshladim. Nihoyat uyga yetib, o‘n soat uxladim.

scenes.title: Hikoya zamonlari: umumiy rasm
board: Past perfect = oldingi voqea (what had happened)
scenes.say_native: Hikoyada uchta o‘tgan zamon birga ishlaydi. Past simple asosiy voqealarni aytadi: ‘I opened the door.’ Past continuous fonni tasvirlaydi: ‘It was raining.’ Past perfect esa hikoyadagi voqeadan oldin bo‘lgan narsani bildiradi: ‘I had forgotten my keys.’ O‘zbek tilida ‘-di’ va ‘-gan edi’ shakllari bor, lekin davomiylik va ketma-ketlik farqi inglizcha shu qadar aniq ifodalanmaydi, shuning uchun bu uchtasini ajratishni mashq qilish kerak.
scenes.say: We use three past tenses in stories. Past simple for the main events, past continuous for the background, and past perfect for things that happened earlier.
scenes.say_uz: Hikoyada uchta o‘tgan zamon ishlatamiz: asosiy voqealar uchun past simple, fon uchun past continuous, oldinroq bo‘lgan voqealar uchun past perfect.

scenes.title: Past simple: voqealar zanjiri
board: irregular: go – went, see – saw, run – ran

examples.t: I opened the door and saw a small box.
examples.uz: Eshikni ochdim va kichik qutini ko‘rdim.

examples.t: She ran to the station and bought a ticket.
examples.uz: U bekatga yugurib bordi va chipta sotib oldi.

scenes.say_native: Past simple hikoyaning ‘skeleti’. Har bir voqea alohida fe’l bilan keladi va tartib bo‘yicha joylashadi. ‘I opened the door. I saw a box. I picked it up.’ Fe’llar ketma-ketligi voqealar ketma-ketligiga mos. Noto‘g‘ri fe’llarni aniq bilish zarur: ‘go – went’, ‘see – saw’, ‘run – ran’, ‘take – took’, ‘find – found’. Bu fe’llarda ‘-ed’ qo‘shilmaydi. O‘zbekchada ham ‘ochdim, ko‘rdim, oldim’ deb ketma-ket aytamiz, shuning uchun bu qism osonroq.
scenes.say: I opened the door and saw a small box. I picked it up and found a note inside. Then I ran downstairs and told my mother.
scenes.say_uz: Eshikni ochdim va kichik qutini ko‘rdim. Uni olib, ichidan xat topdim. So‘ng pastga yugurib borib, onamga aytdim.

scenes.title: Past continuous: fon

examples.t: It was raining and people were running for cover.
examples.uz: Yomg‘ir yog‘ayotgan edi va odamlar panoh izlab yugurishardi.

examples.t: While I was waiting, I was reading a book.

scenes.say_native: Past continuous sahnani chizadi: ob-havo, joy, odamlar nima qilayotgani. ‘It was raining. People were hurrying.’ Bu voqea emas, bu fon. Qolip: ‘was’ yoki ‘were’ va fe’lga ‘-ing’. ‘While’ bilan ikki uzoq davom etgan harakatni bog‘lash mumkin. Fon tasviri tinglovchiga voqea sodir bo‘layotgan muhitni ko‘rsatadi, shuning uchun u hikoya boshida juda foydali.
scenes.say: It was raining and people were hurrying home. While I was waiting at the bus stop, I was reading a book.
scenes.say_uz: Yomg‘ir yog‘ayotgan edi va odamlar uylariga shoshilardi. Avtobus bekatida kutib turganimda kitob o‘qiyotgan edim.

scenes.title: Fon va voqea birga
board: I was walking home when I heard a strange noise.
The sun was shining when the phone rang.
interrupted action: was V-ing + when + V2

examples.t: I was cooking dinner when the lights went out.
We were crossing the bridge when it started to rain.

scenes.say_native: Eng ko‘p ishlatiladigan kombinatsiya: uzoq davom etgan harakat, uni qisqa voqea to‘xtatadi. ‘I was walking home when I heard a noise.’ Uzoq harakat past continuous da, qisqa voqea past simple da. Gap ichida ‘when’ qisqa voqeadan oldin turadi. Bu qolip hikoyada to‘satdan nimadir sodir bo‘lishini ko‘rsatish uchun ideal, ya’ni intriga yaratadi.
scenes.say: I was walking home when I heard a strange noise. The sun was shining when the phone rang. We were crossing the bridge when it started to rain.
scenes.say_uz: Uyga ketayotganimda g‘alati shovqin eshitdim. Quyosh charaqlab turganida telefon jiringladi. Ko‘prikdan o‘tayotganimizda yomg‘ir yog‘a boshladi.

scenes.title: Past perfect: oldingi voqea
board: Oldin sodir bo‘lgan: had forgotten, had lost
By the time / Before / After + past perfect

examples.t: When I arrived, the film had already started.
examples.uz: Men yetib borganimda film allaqachon boshlangan edi.

examples.t: I realised that I had left my passport at home.

scenes.say_native: Past perfect hikoyada orqaga qaytish uchun kerak. Qolip: ‘had’ va fe’lning uchinchi shakli. ‘When I arrived, the film had already started.’ Avval film boshlandi, keyin men keldim. Past perfect asosiy voqeadan oldingi narsani tushuntiradi: ‘I realised I had left my passport at home.’ Ko‘p ishlatiladigan signal so‘zlar: ‘before’, ‘already’, ‘by the time’. Fe’lning uchinchi shakli noto‘g‘ri fe’llarda alohida: ‘left’, ‘lost’, ‘forgotten’, ‘taken’.
scenes.say: When I arrived, the film had already started. I realised that I had left my passport at home. By the time we got there, everyone had gone.
scenes.say_uz: Men yetib borganimda film allaqachon boshlangan edi. Pasportimni uyda qoldirganimni angladim. Biz yetib borgunimizcha hamma ketib bo‘lgan edi.

scenes.title: Uchala zamon bitta hikoyada
scenes.say_native: Endi uchalasini birlashtiramiz. Eshiting: ‘It was raining heavily. I had missed the last bus, so I ran into a cafe.’ Birinchi gap fon, past continuous. Ikkinchisida avtobusdan kechikish oldin bo‘lgan, shuning uchun past perfect, va keyingi voqea past simple da. Har safar o‘zingizdan so‘rang: bu fon, voqea yoki oldingi voqeami? Javobga qarab zamonni tanlaysiz.
scenes.say: It was raining heavily and the streets were empty. I had missed the last bus, so I ran into a small cafe. Inside, a man was playing the guitar.
scenes.say_uz: Qattiq yomg‘ir yog‘ayotgan va ko‘chalar bo‘m-bo‘sh edi. Oxirgi avtobusga ulgurmagan edim, shuning uchun kichik kafega yugurib kirdim. Ichkarida bir odam gitara chalayotgan edi.

scenes.title: Zamonlardagi xatolar
board: ✗ I was opening the door and saw a box.
✓ I opened the door and saw a box.
✗ When I arrived, the film already started.
scenes.say_native: Ikkita xato. Birinchisi: ketma-ket qisqa voqealar uchun past continuous ishlatish. ‘I was opening the door and saw’ noto‘g‘ri, chunki bu ikki ketma-ket qisqa voqea. To‘g‘risi: ‘I opened the door and saw...’. Ikkinchisi: oldingi voqea uchun past simple ishlatish. ‘The film already started’ o‘rniga ‘had already started’. Agar ikkita voqeadan biri ikkinchisidan oldin bo‘lganini ta’kidlamoqchi bo‘lsangiz, past perfect kerak.
scenes.say: Short events in order use past simple. An earlier event needs past perfect: the film had already started.
scenes.say_uz: Ketma-ket qisqa voqealar past simple da. Oldingi voqea past perfect da: the film had already started.

scenes.title: To‘g‘ri zamonni tanlang
board: 1) I (walk) home when it (start) to rain.
3) She (open) the door and (see) a cat.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Qavs ichidagi fe’llarni to‘g‘ri zamonga qo‘ying. Birinchi gap: men uyga ketayotgan edim va yomg‘ir boshlandi. Ikkinchi: biz yetib kelganimizda do‘kon allaqachon yopilgan edi. Uchinchi: u eshikni ochdi va mushukni ko‘rdi. Har bir gapni to‘liq ovoz chiqarib ayting.
scenes.say: Put the verbs in the correct tense. Three sentences: walking and rain, arriving and a closed shop, opening a door.
scenes.say_uz: Fe’llarni to‘g‘ri zamonga qo‘ying. Uchta gap: yurish va yomg‘ir, yetib kelish va yopiq do‘kon, eshikni ochish.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: ‘I was walking home when it started to rain.’ Ikkinchi: ‘When we arrived, the shop had closed’, ya’ni do‘kon biz kelishimizdan oldin yopilgan. Uchinchi: ‘She opened the door and saw a cat.’ Ikkita ketma-ket voqea, ikkalasi ham past simple. Agar ikkinchida ‘closed’ degan bo‘lsangiz, ma’no o‘zgaradi: bu ‘biz kelganimizda do‘kon yopildi’ degani bo‘lardi.
scenes.say: I was walking home when it started to rain. When we arrived, the shop had closed. She opened the door and saw a cat.
scenes.say_uz: Uyga ketayotganimda yomg‘ir boshlandi. Biz yetib borganimizda do‘kon yopilgan edi. U eshikni ochdi va mushukni ko‘rdi.

scenes.title: Voqealarni bog‘lash
board: First, / At first, / Then, / After that,
Meanwhile, / A few minutes later, / By then,

examples.t: Meanwhile, my sister was looking for me.
examples.uz: Shu orada singlim meni qidirayotgan edi.

examples.t: Eventually, a taxi stopped.

scenes.say_native: Hikoyada vaqt iboralari voqealarni bog‘laydi. Boshida: ‘at first’, ‘to begin with’. O‘rtada: ‘then’, ‘after that’, ‘a few minutes later’. Bir vaqtda bo‘layotgan voqealar uchun ‘meanwhile’, ya’ni shu orada. Oxirida: ‘eventually’, ‘in the end’, ‘finally’. ‘Eventually’ uzoq kutishdan keyin natija degani. Muhim: ‘at the end’ va ‘in the end’ bir xil emas. ‘In the end’ — oxir-oqibat, ‘at the end of the film’ esa filmning oxirida.
scenes.say: At first, I thought it was a joke. A few minutes later, I heard the noise again. Meanwhile, my sister was looking for me. Eventually, a taxi stopped.
scenes.say_uz: Avvaliga buni hazil deb o‘yladim. Bir necha daqiqadan keyin shovqinni yana eshitdim. Shu orada singlim meni qidirayotgan edi. Nihoyat, bitta taksi to‘xtadi.

scenes.title: Bog‘lovchi iboralarni qo‘ying
board: 2) We waited for an hour. ___ , the bus came.
3) He was cooking. ___ , I was setting the table.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Uchta gapga mos vaqt iborasini toping. Birinchi: avvaliga men uni tanimadim. Ikkinchi: bir soat kutdik, nihoyat avtobus keldi. Uchinchi: u ovqat pishirayotgan edi, shu orada men dasturxon yozayotgan edim. Variantlar: at first, eventually, meanwhile. Baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Choose: at first, eventually, or meanwhile. Fill each gap.
scenes.say_uz: At first, eventually yoki meanwhile ni tanlab, bo‘sh joylarni to‘ldiring.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: ‘At first, I did not recognise him.’ Ikkinchi: ‘Eventually, the bus came’, uzoq kutishdan keyin natija. Uchinchi: ‘Meanwhile, I was setting the table.’ Shu orada. E’tibor bering, bu so‘zlardan keyin vergul turadi, o‘zbekchada ham ‘shu orada’ dan keyin pauza qilamiz.
scenes.say: At first, I did not recognise him. Eventually, the bus came. Meanwhile, I was setting the table.
scenes.say_uz: Avvaliga uni tanimadim. Nihoyat, avtobus keldi. Shu orada men dasturxon yozayotgan edim.

scenes.title: Intriga yaratish
board: Short sentences. Pause. Then the surprise.
Suddenly, / All of a sudden, / Out of the blue,
I had no idea what was about to happen.

examples.t: Suddenly, the lights went out.
Out of the blue, my phone rang.

scenes.say_native: Intriga uchta usul bilan yaratiladi. Birinchi: qisqa gaplar. Voqea keskinlashganda gaplar qisqaradi: ‘I stopped. Someone was behind me.’ Ikkinchi: pauza, ya’ni aytish oldidan jim bo‘lib turish. Uchinchi: kutilmagan signal iboralari: ‘suddenly’, ‘all of a sudden’, ‘out of the blue’ — kutilmaganda. Va yana ‘I had no idea what was about to happen’ — nima bo‘lishini bilmasdim. Bunday gap tinglovchini kutishga majbur qiladi.
scenes.say: I was walking down the dark street. Footsteps. Behind me. I stopped. Out of the blue, someone shouted my name. I had no idea what was about to happen.
scenes.say_uz: Qorong‘i ko‘chadan ketayotgan edim. Qadam tovushlari. Orqamda. To‘xtadim. Kutilmaganda kimdir ismimni qichqirdi. Nima bo‘lishini bilmasdim.

scenes.title: His-tuyg‘ularni ifodalash
board: My heart was pounding. · My hands were shaking.

examples.t: I was terrified when I heard the noise.
My heart was pounding with excitement.

scenes.say_native: His-tuyg‘ularni ‘I was happy’ yoki ‘I was scared’ degan oddiy so‘zlar bilan cheklamang. Kuchliroq so‘zlar: ‘terrified’, ‘thrilled’, ‘furious’, ‘relieved’. Bundan tashqari, tana bilan ko‘rsating: ‘My heart was pounding’, ‘My hands were shaking’. Bunday tasvir tuyg‘uni aytib o‘tirgandan ko‘ra kuchliroq ta’sir qiladi. Eslang: -ed bilan tugaydigan sifat insonning his-tuyg‘usini bildiradi, -ing esa narsa yoki vaziyatning xususiyatini bildiradi.
scenes.say: I was terrified when I heard the noise. My heart was pounding and my hands were shaking. When I saw it was only the cat, I was so relieved.
scenes.say_uz: Shovqinni eshitganimda dahshatga tushdim. Yuragim gursillab, qo‘llarim titrayotgan edi. Bu faqat mushuk ekanini ko‘rganimda, juda yengil tortdim.

scenes.title: -ed va -ing xatosi
board: ✗ I was very boring at the party.
✓ I was bored at the party. / The party was boring.
✗ The film was exciting for me, I am excited film.
✓ I was excited. / The film was exciting.
scenes.say_native: Bu o‘zbek o‘quvchilari uchun juda keng tarqalgan xato. Agar ‘I was boring’ desangiz, bu ‘men zerikarli odamman’ degani. Siz o‘zingiz zerikkan bo‘lsangiz, ‘I was bored’ deysiz. Kechaning o‘zi zerikarli bo‘lsa, ‘The party was boring’. Qoida: his qiluvchi odam uchun -ed, sabab bo‘lgan narsa uchun -ing. Bu juftliklar ko‘p: ‘interested – interesting’, ‘tired – tiring’, ‘surprised – surprising’.
scenes.say: I was bored because the party was boring. I was excited because the news was exciting.
scenes.say_uz: Men zerikdim, chunki kecha zerikarli edi. Men hayajonlandim, chunki yangilik hayajonli edi.

scenes.title: Hikoyaga intriga qo‘shing
board: I walked into the room. The room was dark.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Oddiy ikki gapni qiziqarli qiling: ‘I walked into the room. The room was dark.’ Unga ‘suddenly’ yoki ‘out of the blue’ bilan kutilmagan voqea qo‘shing, bitta qisqa gap va his-tuyg‘u so‘zi ham ishlating. Masalan, ‘terrified’ yoki ‘relieved’. Uch-to‘rt gap ayting.
scenes.say: Make this boring start exciting. Add a surprise, a short sentence and a strong feeling word.
scenes.say_uz: Bu zerikarli boshlanishni qiziqarli qiling. Kutilmagan voqea, qisqa gap va kuchli his-tuyg‘u so‘zini qo‘shing.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: I walked into the room. It was dark.
Suddenly, I heard breathing. Close. Very close.
I was terrified. Then the light came on. It was my brother!
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javob. ‘I walked into the room. It was dark. Suddenly, I heard breathing. Close. Very close. My heart was pounding, I was terrified. Then the light came on. It was my brother!’ Qisqa gaplar, kutilmagan voqea, tana tasviri va oxirida yengillik. Sizniki boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin, muhimi bu elementlarning bo‘lishi.
scenes.say: I walked into the room. It was dark. Suddenly, I heard breathing. Close. Very close. My heart was pounding. Then the light came on. It was my brother!
scenes.say_uz: Xonaga kirdim. Qorong‘i edi. To‘satdan nafas tovushini eshitdim. Yaqin. Juda yaqin. Yuragim gursillardi. Keyin chiroq yondi. Bu akam edi!

scenes.title: Tinglovchini jalb qilish
board: Guess what happened next! · You won't believe this, but ...
To make a long story short, ...

examples.t: You won't believe what happened next.
To make a long story short, we missed the flight.

scenes.say_native: Hikoya aytayotganda tinglovchi bilan aloqa qiling. ‘Guess what happened next’ — taxmin qiling, keyin nima bo‘ldi. ‘You won’t believe this, but...’ — ishonmaysiz, lekin... Uzun bo‘lib ketsa, ‘To make a long story short’ — gapni qisqa qilsam. Mavzudan chiqib ketsangiz, ‘Anyway’ yoki ‘As I was saying’ bilan qaytasiz. O‘zbekchada ‘xullas’, ‘qisqasi’ deymiz, ularning inglizcha ekvivalenti aynan shular.
scenes.say: You will not believe what happened next. To make a long story short, we missed the flight. Anyway, the important thing is that nobody was hurt.
scenes.say_uz: Keyin nima bo‘lganiga ishonmaysiz. Gapni qisqa qilsam, reysga ulgurmadik. Xullas, muhimi hech kim jarohat olmadi.

scenes.title: Hikoyani tugatish
board: The funny thing is ... · The moral of the story is ...

examples.t: Looking back, it was the best day of my life.
examples.uz: Orqaga qarasam, bu hayotimdagi eng yaxshi kun edi.

examples.t: It taught me never to give up.
examples.uz: U menga hech qachon taslim bo‘lmaslikni o‘rgatdi.

scenes.say_native: Yakun ham hikoyaning muhim qismi. ‘In the end’ — oxir-oqibat. ‘Looking back’ — orqaga qarasam, bu hikoyaga fikr qo‘shadi. ‘The funny thing is...’ — kulgili tomoni shuki. ‘It taught me that...’ — bu menga ... ni o‘rgatdi. Ko‘p odam hikoyani ‘that’s all’ deb keskin tugatadi, lekin yaxshi hikoyachi oxirida his-tuyg‘u yoki saboq beradi. Bu tinglovchi yodida qoladi.
scenes.say: In the end, we laughed about it for years. Looking back, it was the best mistake I ever made. It taught me never to give up.
scenes.say_uz: Oxir-oqibat, bu haqda yillar davomida kulib yurdik. Orqaga qarasam, bu eng yaxshi xato edi. U menga hech qachon taslim bo‘lmaslikni o‘rgatdi.

scenes.title: Tinglang: yo‘qolgan hamyon
scenes.say_native: Endi birinchi hikoya. Do‘st do‘stiga o‘tgan hafta nima bo‘lganini aytib beryapti. Tinglab bo‘lgach, uchta savolga javob berasiz: Liza qayerda edi, u nimani yo‘qotgan edi va hikoya qanday tugadi. Zamonlar va bog‘lovchi iboralarga e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: Guess what happened to me last week! I was standing in a queue at the supermarket when I realised I had left my wallet at home. Everyone was staring at me. I was so embarrassed. Then the old man behind me smiled and paid for my shopping. I could not believe it. In the end, I took his address and sent him a thank-you card.
scenes.say_uz: Taxmin qil, o‘tgan hafta menga nima bo‘ldi! Supermarketda navbatda turgan edim, hamyonimni uyda qoldirganimni angladim. Hamma menga tikilib turardi. Juda uyaldim. Keyin orqamdagi keksa odam jilmayib, xaridimni to‘lab berdi. Ishonolmadim. Oxirida uning manzilini olib, minnatdorchilik kartochkasi yubordim.

scenes.title: Savollarga javob bering
board: 2) What had she done before she arrived?
3) How did she feel? How did the story end?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi: Liza qayerda edi? Ikkinchi: u supermarketga kelishdan oldin nima qilgan edi? Uchinchi: u o‘zini qanday his qildi va hikoya qanday tugadi? Javoblarni to‘liq gap bilan, hikoyadagi zamonlarni ishlatib ayting.
scenes.say: Where was Lisa? What had she done before she arrived? How did she feel, and how did the story end?
scenes.say_uz: Liza qayerda edi? U kelishdan oldin nima qilgan edi? U o‘zini qanday his qildi va hikoya qanday tugadi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) In a queue at a supermarket
2) She had left her wallet at home
3) Embarrassed. An old man paid; she sent a thank-you card
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: Liza supermarketda, navbatda turgan edi. Ikkinchi: u hamyonini uyda qoldirgan edi, bu past perfect. Uchinchi: u juda uyaldi, keyin keksa odam uning xaridini to‘lab berdi va oxirida Liza unga minnatdorchilik kartochkasi yubordi. Eslang, ‘Guess what happened’ bilan boshlangan hikoya tinglovchini darhol jalb qildi.
scenes.say: Lisa was in a queue at the supermarket. She had left her wallet at home. She felt embarrassed, but an old man paid for her shopping.
scenes.say_uz: Liza supermarketda navbatda edi. U hamyonini uyda qoldirgan edi. U uyaldi, lekin keksa odam xaridini to‘lab berdi.

scenes.title: Tinglang: oxirgi poyezd
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi hikoya biroz uzunroq va unda ko‘proq intriga bor. Daniel o‘zining sayohati haqida aytib beryapti. Tinglang va quyidagilarni aniqlang: Daniel nega kech qoldi, notanish odam nima qildi va Daniel hozir bu voqeani qanday eslaydi. Qisqa gaplar va pauzalarni ham eshitishga harakat qiling.
scenes.say: It all started when I missed my train in Manchester. It was midnight and it was freezing. I had no idea what to do. Suddenly, a woman called my name. It was my old teacher! She was driving home, so she gave me a lift. To make a long story short, I slept in her spare room. Looking back, it was a lucky mistake.
scenes.say_uz: Hammasi Manchesterda poyezdga ulgurmaganimdan boshlandi. Yarim tun edi va juda sovuq edi. Nima qilishni bilmasdim. To‘satdan bir ayol ismimni chaqirdi. Bu mening eski o‘qituvchim edi! U uyiga ketayotgan edi, shuning uchun meni mashinasida olib ketdi. Qisqasi, uning mehmon xonasida uxladim. Orqaga qarasam, bu omadli xato edi.

scenes.title: Savollarga javob bering
board: 3) How does he feel about it now?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi: Daniel nega qolib ketdi? Ikkinchi: kim uning ismini chaqirdi? Uchinchi: u hozir bu voqeani qanday baholaydi? Bundan tashqari, hikoyada qaysi intriga iborasi ishlatilganini ham aytib bering.
scenes.say: Why was Daniel stuck? Who called his name? How does he feel about it now? Which suspense phrase did he use?
scenes.say_uz: Daniel nega qolib ketdi? Kim uning ismini chaqirdi? U hozir qanday his qiladi? U qaysi intriga iborasidan foydalandi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) He missed his train in Manchester
3) It was a lucky mistake · Suddenly / To make a long story short
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: Daniel Manchesterda poyezdga ulgurmagan edi. Ikkinchi: uning ismini eski o‘qituvchisi chaqirdi. Uchinchi: u buni omadli xato deb hisoblaydi. Intriga iborasi: ‘Suddenly’. Bundan tashqari, ‘It all started when’, ‘To make a long story short’ va ‘Looking back’ ham ishlatildi: bugungi iboralar uchta qismga aniq joylashdi.
scenes.say: Daniel missed his train. His old teacher called his name. Looking back, he thinks it was a lucky mistake.
scenes.say_uz: Daniel poyezdga ulgurmadi. Uning ismini eski o‘qituvchisi chaqirdi. U orqaga qarab, buni omadli xato deb hisoblaydi.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: ohang, pauza va kuchsiz shakllar
board: Pause before the surprise: ... (1 sec) Suddenly,
scenes.say_native: Hikoyaning yarmi ovozda. Birinchi, pauza: kutilmagan voqeadan oldin bir soniya jim turing. Ikkinchi, ohang: keskin payt yaqinlashganda ovozingiz pastroq va sekinroq bo‘lsin, yengillikda esa yorug‘roq. Uchinchi, kuchsiz shakllar: ‘had’ odatda ‘həd’ yoki ‘’d’ deb qisqa aytiladi: ‘I’d lost my keys’. ‘Was’ ‘wəz’ ga yaqin. Faqat ma’noli so‘zlarga urg‘u bering: ‘I’d LOST my KEYS’.
scenes.say: I'd lost my keys. It was dark. I was alone. Pause. Suddenly, the door opened.
scenes.say_uz: Kalitlarimni yo‘qotgan edim. Qorong‘i edi. Yolg‘iz edim. Pauza. To‘satdan eshik ochildi.

scenes.title: Pauza bilan ayting
board: It was DARK. ... (pause) ... SUDDENLY, the door OPENED.
Voice: slow and low before the surprise
scenes.say_native: Takrorlang. Ekrandagi uch gapni ovoz bilan o‘ynang. ‘I’d lost my keys’ da ‘I’d’ ni qisqa va yengil ayting. ‘Suddenly’ dan oldin bir soniya jim turing va ovozingiz sekin bo‘lsin. Avval pastroq, keyin keskin payt. Bir necha marta takrorlang.
scenes.say: I'd lost my keys. It was dark. Pause. Suddenly, the door opened.
scenes.say_uz: Kalitlarimni yo‘qotgan edim. Qorong‘i edi. Pauza. To‘satdan eshik ochildi.

scenes.title: Hikoya rejasi
board: Problem + climax: what happened? how did you feel?
scenes.say_native: Endi yakuniy topshiriqqa tayyorlanamiz. Gapirishdan oldin yarim daqiqa rejaga sarflang. Setting: qachon, qayerda, kim bilan. Muammo va keskin payt: nima bo‘ldi va nima his qildingiz. Yakun: natija va fikringiz. Hammasini yozib chiqmang, faqat kalit so‘zlarni yozing. Hikoyangiz yodlangan matn kabi emas, tabiiy eshitilishi kerak.
scenes.say: Before you tell a story, plan it. Write only key words: setting, problem, climax and ending.
scenes.say_uz: Hikoya aytishdan oldin reja tuzing. Faqat kalit so‘zlarni yozing: setting, muammo, keskin payt va yakun.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: 1 daqiqalik hikoya
board: Topic: a day when something unexpected happened
Use: past simple + past continuous + past perfect
Use: 1 suspense phrase + 1 feeling + a strong ending
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy topshiriq. Kutilmagan voqea bo‘lgan bir kun haqida bir daqiqalik hikoya aytib bering. Setting bilan boshlang, uchta o‘tgan zamonni ishlating, bitta intriga iborasi va bitta kuchli his-tuyg‘u so‘zini qo‘shing, oxirida xulosa chiqaring. Videoni to‘xtatib, ovoz chiqarib gapiring.
scenes.say: Tell a one-minute story about a day when something unexpected happened. Start now.
scenes.say_uz: Kutilmagan voqea bo‘lgan bir kun haqida bir daqiqalik hikoya aytib bering. Boshlang.

scenes.title: Namunaviy hikoya
scenes.say_native: Mana namuna. ‘Last year I was working in the garden when my neighbour shouted. His dog had escaped! We searched the whole street. Out of the blue, I heard barking from the bakery. I was so relieved. In the end, the baker gave us a free loaf.’ Qismlar, zamonlar va intriga aniq ko‘rinadi. Sizning hikoyangizda ham shular bor edimi? Unda maqsadingizga yetdingiz.
scenes.say: Last year I was working in the garden when my neighbour shouted. His dog had escaped! We searched the whole street. Out of the blue, I heard barking from the bakery. I was so relieved. In the end, the baker gave us a free loaf.
scenes.say_uz: O‘tgan yili bog‘da ishlayotganimda qo‘shnim qichqirdi. Uning iti qochib ketgan edi! Butun ko‘chani qidirdik. Kutilmaganda novvoyxonadan akillash eshitildi. Juda yengil tortdim. Oxirida novvoy bizga bepul non berdi.

scenes.title: Bugun nimani o‘rgandik
board: Tenses: past simple · past continuous · past perfect
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Hikoyaning to‘rt qismini: setting, muammo, keskin payt va yakunni o‘rgandik. Hikoya zamonlarini: voqealar uchun past simple, fon uchun past continuous, oldingi voqea uchun past perfect. Intriga uchun qisqa gaplar, pauza va ‘suddenly’ kabi iboralarni, his-tuyg‘u uchun kuchli sifatlar va -ed, -ing farqini mashq qildik. Va hikoya iboralari: ‘It all started when’, ‘You won’t believe it’, ‘Looking back’.
scenes.say: Great work today. Now you can tell a story with a clear structure, the right tenses, suspense and feeling.
scenes.say_uz: Bugun ajoyib ishladingiz. Endi aniq tuzilma, to‘g‘ri zamonlar, intriga va tuyg‘u bilan hikoya aytib bera olasiz.

scenes.title: Uyga vazifa
board: 3 tenses · 1 suspense phrase · 1 feeling · 2 storytelling phrases
scenes.say_native: Uyga vazifa. O‘zingizning hayotingizdan bir voqeani ikki daqiqa davomida aytib, telefoningizga yozib oling. Mezon: to‘rtta qism bo‘lsin, uchta o‘tgan zamon ishlatilsin, kamida bitta intriga iborasi, bitta kuchli his-tuyg‘u so‘zi va ikkita hikoya iborasi bo‘lsin. Keyin yozuvni tinglab tekshiring: ‘bored’ va ‘boring’ aralashmaganmi. Keyingi darsda muammo va yechim haqida gapirishni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Your homework is a two-minute personal story. Record it and check the structure. See you next time.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifangiz ikki daqiqalik shaxsiy hikoya. Uni yozib oling va tuzilmasini tekshiring. Keyingi darsda ko‘rishamiz.

homework_uz: O‘zingiz bilan bo‘lgan voqeani ikki daqiqa davomida aytib, ovozini yozib oling. Mezon: setting, muammo, keskin payt va yakun bo‘lsin; past simple, past continuous va past perfect ishlatilsin; kamida bitta intriga iborasi (suddenly, out of the blue), bitta kuchli his-tuyg‘u so‘zi va ikkita hikoya iborasi (It all started when, Looking back) bo‘lsin. Yozuvni tinglab, bored va boring aralashmaganini tekshiring.

quiz.q: Which part of a story tells where and when it happened?
quiz.why_uz: Setting joy, vaqt va qatnashuvchilarni tasvirlaydi.

quiz.q: I ___ home when I heard a noise.
quiz.why_uz: Uzoq harakat past continuous, uni to‘xtatgan voqea past simple.
Oldin sodir bo‘lgan voqea past perfect da: had already started.

options: I opened the door and I was seeing a cat.
I opened the door and saw a cat.
I was opening the door and saw a cat.
I had opened the door and saw a cat.
quiz.why_uz: Ketma-ket qisqa voqealar past simple da.

quiz.q: The party was very ___, so I went home early.
quiz.why_uz: Narsa (kecha) uchun -ing: boring. Inson uchun bored.

quiz.q: I was ___ because the news was so surprising.

options: Out of the blue, the phone rang.
And then, and then, and then.
quiz.why_uz: Out of the blue — kutilmaganda: intriga signali.

options: At the end of the story, finally the end
quiz.why_uz: Qat’iy ibora: on the other hand. Yakunda in the end ishlatiladi.

quiz.q: Which phrase makes a long story shorter?
options: To make a long story short
quiz.why_uz: To make a long story short — gapni qisqa qilsam.

quiz.q: It was dark. ___ the door opened.
